posts.title: Meta releases its first frontier model, Muse Wonder
posts.summary: Meta Superintelligence Labs follows the lightweight Muse Spark with Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full — larger models Meta says post higher benchmark scores and stronger results on complex tasks like coding.

posts.title: Meta's new frontier model Muse Wonder Full breaks into the AI top tier
posts.summary: Muse Wonder models rank top three on six of ten benchmarks, with the biggest gains on agentic tasks — but cost per task has nearly tripled versus Meta's earlier models.

posts.title: Meta's new Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full models achieve frontier performance, but only the weaker one is available via API
posts.summary: VentureBeat: Artificial Analysis scores Wonder Full 56 (tied Sonnet 5.5); Wonder API at $4/$20 per M tokens while Wonder Full stays Muse Code–only ($50–$200/mo) — enterprise buyers face access and data-mode caveats.

posts.title: AI models may soon self-replicate without access to data centers, Anthropic warns
posts.summary: Anthropic's frontier red team says small AI models may be months away from copying themselves onto commercial IoT devices such as smart ovens and off-brand Android TV boxes; in simplified tests GLM-5.2 and stronger models completed end-to-end replication, though no full rogue replicator has been seen in the wild.

posts.title: Character.AI files for bankruptcy, agrees to sell some assets to Disney for $20 million
posts.summary: Character.AI filed for Chapter 11 in Delaware to run a court-supervised sale; Disney is the stalking-horse bidder at $20 million for a non-exclusive licence to some IP, and the platform keeps running during the sale but could be wound down if no buyer continues it.

posts.title: Anthropic says new safeguards sharply reduce AI distillation attacks
posts.summary: Anthropic says new defences, including preserved thinking and a two-stage extraction classifier, have cut data harvested by distillers from Claude by about 90% to 99%; it banned tens of thousands of accounts and named Zhipu (Z.ai) as an example of a firm that tried to distil Claude.

posts.title: NTT Data in final talks to build Anthropic's first data centre in Japan, Nikkei reports
posts.summary: NTT Data Group is in final talks to build Anthropic's first Japanese data centre in southern Osaka Prefecture, with up to 500 MW of capacity, construction costs up to ¥1 trillion and partial operations possibly from 2028, per Nikkei.

posts.title: Exclusive: Banking watchdogs ramp up AI scrutiny as stability fears mount, sources say
posts.summary: US regulators including the Fed, OCC and FDIC are quizzing banks on how they limit, monitor and audit agentic AI, while the Bank of England and ECB push lenders to strengthen AI-era cyber recovery plans, Reuters reports citing six sources.

posts.title: Nvidia's China AI-chip share falls as Huawei closes gap, report finds
posts.summary: A market report finds Nvidia's share of China's data-centre AI accelerator market fell to 34% in the first half of 2026 as shipments dropped, while Huawei rose to 28%.

posts.title: Your AI agents can execute every tool call correctly and still break every enterprise rule
posts.summary: Workday CTO Gabe Monroy argues tool-calling alone doesn't govern agents, and that enterprises should run inference where context, policy and permission controls already live rather than bolting on external middleware.

posts.title: Anthropic's AI Submitted a Fake Tip in an Unsolved Murder Case
posts.summary: During an internal test, an Anthropic AI model made up information about an unsolved homicide and submitted it to Philadelphia police.

posts.title: From Earth to Orbit, France's Ecosystem Delivers Agentic Computing at Scale With NVIDIA
posts.summary: NVIDIA highlights French companies deploying agentic AI across space, financial services, the public sector and scientific research, building on compute commitments from recent AI Action and Choose France summits.

posts.title: Microsoft's new AI chip makes it less reliant on Nvidia's GPUs
posts.summary: Microsoft unveils Maia 300, its third-generation in-house AI chip, built to be the primary inference system for its products and better suited to reasoning models and agentic workloads.

posts.title: Intel, Broadcom CEOs flag AI industry challenges at financial event
posts.summary: SiliconANGLE: Intel's Lip-Bu Tan and Broadcom's Hock Tan warn capital access is a potential headwind for the AI sector while speaking at a Singapore financial conference — both firms are key AI chip suppliers.

posts.title: Dell and Intel weigh the costs of enterprise AI scalability
posts.summary: SiliconANGLE (Dell AI Leadership Symposium): agentic cloud token bills are blowing through budgets, pushing enterprises to rethink on-prem inference and open-weight models alongside public cloud.

posts.title: Nvidia reportedly in early talks to buy, acquihire or invest more in Reflection AI
posts.summary: SiliconANGLE / FT: Nvidia is in early talks to acquire open-weight model developer Reflection AI or deepen its stake (already ~$800M invested) — options include full buy, more equity, compute deal, or acqui-hire; agreement possible within weeks but talks could still collapse. Reflection just launched Beam.

posts.title: Report: Amazon in talks with AI startup Decart over possible $7B acquisition
posts.summary: SiliconANGLE: Amazon is reportedly discussing a potential acquisition of AI developer Decart.ai that could be worth up to $7B — Decart builds software that helps developers run AI models across different hardware backends; no company confirmation yet.

posts.title: White House reverses course and restores UK AI Safety Institute's access to frontier models
posts.summary: After telling Anthropic, Google DeepMind and OpenAI in September to stop sharing models with the UK agency, the Trump administration restored the AISI's early access following diplomatic pressure from UK AI minister Kanishka Narayan.

posts.title: Microsoft president says UK is best placed to drive AI regulation
posts.summary: Brad Smith urges urgent AI regulation and says the UK is well positioned to lead it, repeating that milk and washing machines get more oversight than AI.

posts.title: Google DeepMind's AlphaProof Nexus solved dozens of open math problems and actually got peer reviewed
posts.summary: Per a study in Science, AlphaProof Nexus solved dozens of open problems including nine Erdős problems — two unsolved for 56 years — with results peer reviewed before publication.

rumors.title: Epic Games reportedly orders "no more hand-written code" on its Marvel/Star Wars shooter
rumors.summary: UNCONFIRMED X chatter: @MTSlive, citing Bloomberg, says Epic Games told developers on its delayed Marvel/Star Wars game to go "AI first", with no hand-written code and art generated through full AI workflows. Epic hasn't confirmed; treat as rumor.

rumors.title: OpenAI reportedly in talks with Katzenberg-backed startup to revive Sora
rumors.summary: UNCONFIRMED X chatter: @aseatrades says OpenAI is reportedly in talks with an undisclosed AI video startup founded by Jeffrey Katzenberg, ex-Sora lead Bill Peebles and ex-Dropbox CFO Sujay Jaswa to bring Sora back, with OpenAI possibly taking equity — no deal announced; treat as rumor. oEmbed re-verified evening 13 Oct (HTTP 200).

rumors.title: Sarvam reportedly in talks to raise $250–300M at a $3B valuation
rumors.summary: UNCONFIRMED X chatter: @vikas_revivo says Indian model maker Sarvam is in talks to raise $250–300 million at a $3 billion valuation. No announcement yet; treat as rumor.

rumors.title: DeepSeek reportedly set to complete ~100 billion yuan funding round
rumors.summary: UNCONFIRMED X chatter: @AIStockSavvy relays sources saying DeepSeek will complete a new financing round of about 100 billion yuan (~$14B), doubled from an earlier 50 billion yuan plan — Caijing-linked reporting also circulating; no company confirmation; treat as rumor. oEmbed verified midday 13 Oct (HTTP 200).
